description:
Travel Checklist Builder creates a FREE, personalized travel checklist based on your trip details and preferences.

Tell us where you’re going, how long you’ll be away, who’s traveling, and what activities you plan — and we’ll generate a clear, organized packing and planning list you can view, edit, and print.

This tool helps you:
- Prepare for any trip with tailored essentials
- Include climate, activity, and group-specific items
- Get pre-departure reminders and packing categories
- Print or export your checklist for offline use

No generic lists — every checklist is customized to your trip profile.

defaultPrompt: Create A Personalized Travel Checklist For Me
What should I pack on my trip to Miami?
My wife and kids are traveling to California, what should they pack?

publication.release_notes: Replacement on the app-specific shared HTTPS MCP origin. Add review cases and walkthrough; repair observed input hydration and unsupported claims where applicable. Existing published listing remains live.

positive.prompt: Open ChecklistIQ for manual trip details.
positive.expected_behavior: Open a packing checklist with editable trip details.

positive.prompt: Make a carry-on packing checklist for a seven-day tropical beach trip to Cancun.
positive.expected_behavior: Use destination, duration, climate, beach purpose and carry-on constraint.

positive.prompt: Make a three-day business-trip checklist for London in November.
positive.expected_behavior: Show a business-trip checklist retaining London and three-day duration.

positive.prompt: Make a five-day winter hiking checklist for Banff.
positive.expected_behavior: Include a checklist suited to the explicit winter hiking trip.

positive.prompt: Make a two-week city-trip checklist for Lisbon with remote-work items.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the two-week duration and remote-worker preset with editable checklist items.

negative.prompt: Book and pay for flights to London.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not book flights or request payment details.

negative.prompt: Guarantee my visa and entry eligibility.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim a packing checklist determines visa eligibility.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this app for an unrelated writing task.
